verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing provides machine learning-generated risk scores (fraud, dispute, card-testing) on every authorization, which is a form of AI-generated insight from transaction data inside the product, but this is a narrow, single-purpose scoring feature rather than broader AI-generated insights/suggestions across the product's data (e.g., spending pattern analysis, budget recommendations, natural-language summaries). Missing for 10: general AI-driven analytics/insights dashboard, proactive suggestions beyond fraud scoring, and any independent/hands-on corroboration of this feature's usefulness.
